coverage_issues: Report 1 (qwen3-235b) failed to audit .gitignore and PKGBUILD due to API errors (HTTP 400 BadRequestError), leaving 2 of 3 files unaudited
learnings: When a model encounters API errors during file review, the tool should distinguish between 'inconclusive due to tool failure' and 'inconclusive due to security concerns' - the former should not block a verdict if other successful audits cover the same files
The audit tool should implement retry logic or fallback models when API errors occur, to prevent incomplete coverage from forcing inconclusive verdicts
Initial PKGBUILD safety checks (for makepkg sourcing) should be weighted appropriately when full file review fails due to tool errors, as they still provide partial security assurance
